<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Delivery zones and their prices as a table or as cards: the zone and its areas, the price, the order that
  ships free, the minimum order, the time and an express badge. Axes: layout (table, cards), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Zone, ZoneLabels } from "./zone-table.types";

export type ZoneTableProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  zones: Zone[];
  empty?: string;
  labels: ZoneLabels;
  layout?: "table" | "cards";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Badge from "../compose/Badge.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import ZoneRows from "../components/zone-rows.vue";
import { fmtMoney } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  zones,
  empty = "",
  labels,
  layout = "table",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<ZoneTableProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <EmptyState v-if="((zones?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="map" :title="empty" />
    <ZoneRows v-else-if="((layout as string) === 'table')" :zones="zones" :labels="labels" />
    <Grid v-else cols="1-3" class="gap-4" data-slot="items">
      <Stack
        v-for="z in zones"
        :key="z.id"
        gap="4"
        class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6"
        data-slot="item"
      >
        <Stack gap="2">
          <Title :as="3" size="lg" weight="bold">
            {{ z.name }}
          </Title>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ z.area }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Text size="3xl" weight="bold">
          {{ fmtMoney(z.price, z.currency) }}
        </Text>
        <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-border pt-4">
          <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
            <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ labels.freeFrom }}
            </Inline>
            <Inline class="font-medium">
              {{ fmtMoney(z.freeFrom, z.currency) }}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
          <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
            <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ labels.minOrder }}
            </Inline>
            <Inline class="font-medium">
              {{ fmtMoney(z.minOrder, z.currency) }}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
          <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
            <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ labels.time }}
            </Inline>
            <Inline class="font-medium">
              {{ z.time }}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
        <Badge v-if="z.express" variant="secondary" size="default" class="w-fit">
          {{ z.express }}
        </Badge>
      </Stack>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
